blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipality of Narvacan formally opened its first Bagnet Festival on Saturday, Sept. 26, as part of its celebration of Tourism Month. The annual festival seeks to showcase Narvacan’s culture, local products and culinary tradition while promoting unity and community participation, Mayor Edna Cabalo Sanidad said. The festival kicked off with a Mass at Our Lady of Mount Carmel, attended by local government officials led by Sanidad, Vice Mayor Margarito Tejada and Municipal Administrator Atty. Jamyrah Sanidad, along with members of the municipal council, the 34 barangay captains and municipal employees. The religious service was followed […]...
